# Reproducible LaTeX build script.
# Compiles /protected/document.tex + /protected/references.bib into /app/document.pdf
# using pdflatex + bibtex. Output is bit-for-bit identical for a fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
set -euo pipefail

SRC_TEX="/protected/document.tex"
SRC_BIB="/protected/references.bib"
BUILD_DIR="/app"
JOBNAME="document"
OUT_PDF="/app/document.pdf"

# --- 1. Deterministic environment -------------------------------------------
# Handle missing SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: fall back to source mtime, else current time.
if [ -z "${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:-}" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is not set; using fallback value." >&2
    FALLBACK=""
    if [ -f "${SRC_TEX}" ]; then
        FALLBACK="$(stat -c %Y "${SRC_TEX}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    fi
    if [ -z "${FALLBACK}" ]; then
        FALLBACK="$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    fi
    SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="${FALLBACK}"
    echo "WARNING: using SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}." >&2
fi

# Validate SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is a non-negative integer.
if ! printf '%s' "${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
    echo "ERROR: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH='${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}' is not a non-negative integer (seconds since epoch)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
# FORCE_SOURCE_DATE makes pdfTeX use SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for CreationDate/ModDate,
# deterministic trailer /ID, and deterministic \year\month\day\time (\today).
export FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1
# Makes TeX primitives (\year,\month,\day,\time) use SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH where supported.
export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH_TEX_PRIMITIVES=1
# Deterministic archiver timestamps (standard reproducible-builds flag).
export ZERO_AR_DATE=1
# Fixed timezone/locale so date formatting does not vary by builder locale.
export TZ=UTC
export LC_ALL=C
export LC_TIME=C

# --- 2. Tool / input checks --------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: pdflatex not found in PATH." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v bibtex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: bibtex not found in PATH." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "${SRC_TEX}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: LaTeX source not found: ${SRC_TEX}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "${SRC_BIB}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: bibliography file not found: ${SRC_BIB}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "${BUILD_DIR}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: build directory not found: ${BUILD_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --- 3. Prepare deterministic build directory --------------------------------
# Remove stale generated files so each build starts from a clean state.
rm -f "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.pdf" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.aux" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.bbl" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.blg" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.log" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.out" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.toc" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.lof" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.lot" \
      "${BUILD_DIR}/missfont.log"

# Stage sources under fixed names in the fixed build directory. Using a fixed
# directory (instead of mktemp -d) avoids leaking random temp paths into the
# build and keeps the build hermetic across runs.
cp -f "${SRC_TEX}" "${BUILD_DIR}/${JOBNAME}.tex"
cp -f "${SRC_BIB}" "${BUILD_DIR}/references.bib"

cd "${BUILD_DIR}"

# --- 4. Compilation (pdflatex -> bibtex -> pdflatex -> pdflatex) -------------
echo "Building ${JOBNAME}.pdf with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} ..."

# First pdflatex pass: generates .aux for bibtex. Fatal LaTeX syntax errors
# abort here (non-zero exit + set -e).
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${JOBNAME}.tex"; then
    echo "ERROR: first pdflatex pass failed (invalid LaTeX syntax?). See ${JOBNAME}.log." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# BibTeX pass: resolve bibliography. Missing entries / warnings must not abort
# the whole build; the document still compiles (with [?] markers), so treat a
# non-zero bibtex status as a warning and continue to the remaining passes.
if [ -f "${JOBNAME}.aux" ]; then
    if grep -q "bibdata" "${JOBNAME}.aux" 2>/dev/null; then
        set +e
        bibtex "${JOBNAME}"
        BIBTEX_STATUS=$?
        set -e
        if [ ${BIBTEX_STATUS} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "WARNING: bibtex exited with status ${BIBTEX_STATUS} (missing entries or warnings?); continuing." >&2
        fi
        if [ ! -f "${JOBNAME}.bbl" ]; then
            echo "WARNING: ${JOBNAME}.bbl not produced by bibtex; continuing without bibliography." >&2
        fi
    else
        echo "NOTE: no \\bibliography data in .aux; skipping bibtex." >&2
    fi
else
    echo "ERROR: ${JOBNAME}.aux not produced by first pdflatex pass." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Second pdflatex pass: incorporates .bbl.
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${JOBNAME}.tex"; then
    echo "ERROR: second pdflatex pass failed. See ${JOBNAME}.log." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Third pdflatex pass: resolves remaining cross-references / citations.
if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${JOBNAME}.tex"; then
    echo "ERROR: third pdflatex pass failed. See ${JOBNAME}.log." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --- 5. Verify + normalize output --------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "${OUT_PDF}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: expected output not produced: ${OUT_PDF}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "${OUT_PDF}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: produced PDF is empty: ${OUT_PDF}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Normalize the output file mtime to SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH so even filesystem
# metadata is reproducible (does not affect PDF bytes).
touch -d "@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" "${OUT_PDF}" 2>/dev/null || touch -d "1970-01-01 UTC + ${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH} seconds" "${OUT_PDF}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Build succeeded: ${OUT_PDF}"
